workflow: A stream operation begins by flushing its associated buffering layer before completing the requested operation.
Flushing invokes user-controlled callback code on the underlying layer.
The callback re-enters the stream and detaches or releases its backing resource, clearing the association while the original operation remains active.
The original operation fails to revalidate the backing resource and dereferences the cleared handle, causing a null-pointer crash instead of reporting a reentrant-operation error.
summary: Reentrant callback invalidates a backing resource before continued use
